_about: What was actually sent to Meshy for the 17 models whose prompts tools/meshy/prompts.json can't give word for word, taken from the session logs on 2026-11-14. prompts.json stays the record to make new models from; this is how these 17 were really made. Each model's steps run in order: a picture, any fixes, the 3D model, the rig (scenery has no rig). `from` is what a step started from: a task id, or a file in this repo with `from_task`, the task that made that file. Every task is on the Meshy account in this machine's MCP config, so a download needs only the id. `sent` is UTC. `node tools/meshy/prompt.mjs <key> sent` prints one model's steps.

necromancer_m.why: prompts.json added "(plain coffin lids, no crosses)" to the necromancer line after this was sent; nothing else differs.

steps.prompt: A courteous undertaker-mage, a tall thin man; a tailored funeral coat of deep violet velvet with silver embroidery and a row of carved bone clasps, a tall mourning hat draped with a black veil, a short mantle of raven feathers, an ornate silver coffin-handle pauldron on one shoulder, a rosary of finger bones, fine black gloves, grave dirt on a hem of black lace; the male cut of this class costume, same colours. Original character design for a dark gothic high-fantasy MMORPG, in the ornate job-armor tradition of Final Fantasy XIV artifact gear: tall elegant realistic proportions, about 7.5 heads, intricate layered costume with engraved filigree borders, rich brocade, tooled leather and jeweled fittings, asymmetric silhouette, long trailing cloth. Grimdark palette of blackened grave steel, tarnished gold, deep wine, night indigo and bone ivory; worn, battle-scarred, candle-sooted; sombre and regal, never cute, never generic. Semi-realistic painted 3D game character, very high detail. Abstract scrollwork decoration only: no text, letters, runes, heraldic emblems or logos anywhere. Full-body character sheet, front view, standing straight in an A-pose with the arms held 40 degrees from the body, hands open and empty, legs slightly apart, the whole figure visible from the top of the headpiece to the soles with a margin, flat neutral studio lighting, plain light grey background, single character, no weapon, nothing held in the hands.
